content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Bitcoin payment

This framework empowers digital creators to sell their products directly to consumers using Bitcoin, circumventing the limitations imposed by traditional payment processors. It matters because it restores autonomy and profitability for those who have been excluded from mainstream payment options. By integrating NOWPayments, creators can accept a wide array of cryptocurrencies, significantly lowering transaction costs compared to platforms charging as much as 10% per sale.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture consists of several components working in harmony. Using tools like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, creators can automate the delivery of digital downloads upon payment confirmation. NOWPayments facilitates seamless cryptocurrency transactions, converting values in real time to ensure that creators receive payments in USD equivalent. This setup eliminates the dependency on traditional banking systems, providing a streamlined, efficient solution.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is designed specifically for digital creators in regions where conventional payment platforms are either unavailable or heavily restricted. Whether you are selling ebooks, courses, or software, this system allows you to bypass high fees and retain more of your earnings. By using this architecture, creators are positioned to maximize their profits while maintaining complete control over their products and customer data.
With NOWPayments, you keep more of your earnings — just a 0.5% fee.
The Components That Make It Work Together

At its core, this solution is made up of free hosting services like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, backend logic from Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, and secure payment processing via NOWPayments. Together, these components create a robust infrastructure that supports automatic delivery of digital content and facilitates payment processing without middlemen. This architecture not only simplifies the selling process but also enhances the customer experience.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy this infrastructure, start by selecting the Complete Builder Kit ($197) to access all necessary blueprints and templates. Set up your hosting environment on Cloudflare or GitHub, integrate NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions, and configure your backend logic to handle product deliveries. Finally, test your setup thoroughly to ensure a seamless experience for your customers. With these steps, you can launch your digital product store almost immediately.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, consider using a framework that allows cryptocurrency payments through services like NOWPayments. This enables you to accept Bitcoin or other cryptocurrencies, maintaining higher profit margins by avoiding hefty fees from traditional platforms. Each transaction incurs just a 0.5% fee, which can save you significant amounts over time, especially if you're selling high volumes of digital products.
No subscriptions mean lifetime access to your infrastructure.

If you're looking to sell digital downloads without relying on platforms like Gumroad or Payhip, the architecture we've discussed is your solution. Explore the Complete Builder Kit ($197) to access all necessary components for building your sovereign digital commerce stack. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to get started.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I accept Bitcoin payments for digital downloads?

To accept Bitcoin payments, integrate NOWPayments into your digital store. This service allows you to receive payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies with minimal fees, ensuring your transactions are both secure and efficient.
What fees will I incur using NOWPayments?

NOWPayments charges a low transaction fee of just 0.5%, a fraction of what platforms like Gumroad charge. For example, on a $97 product sold 100 times, you retain $921 more by using NOWPayments instead of Gumroad.
What digital products can I sell using this infrastructure?

You can sell a variety of digital products including ebooks, online courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, and software. This framework is designed to accommodate any digital content you wish to monetize.
Is there any ongoing cost after setup?
No, once you set up your digital store using this architecture, there are no ongoing subscription fees. You own everything, and there are no platform restrictions or additional costs once deployed.
How quickly can I set up my store?
